subject: Compact QBR + roadmap: compressed window request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cogentcloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@cogentcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Compact QBR + roadmap: compressed window request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the renewal. Our execs are strapped for time next week and asked if we can compress the usual 2.5-hour QBR + roadmap into a tight 90-minute on-demand session that still covers outcomes, roadmap highlights, and a short technical deep-dive.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Thu Aug 20 — 10:30–12:00
- Thu Aug 20 — 16:00–17:30

If we must choose one, the preference is the morning slot. We also need to confirm: will the technical deep-dive include infra sizing and the Dedicated capacity cost model? That’s important for procurement.

Recording is fine, but our legal needs explicit confirmation that recordings and any shared artifacts are stored only in the customer folder we agreed on.

Appreciate a quick check — execs want a calendar invite by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Partnerships | CogentCloud
Attachment: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cogentcloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact QBR + roadmap: compressed window request

Samantha —

We can absolutely run a compressed session. To make the 90 minutes productive I propose an "availability auction" approach: you pick the preferred window (looks like you want Thu morning), we lock the core agenda and then internal owners commit to tight timeboxes.

Quick plan:
- 10 min — Exec kick-off (sales lead)
- 30 min — Roadmap highlights (product lead)
- 30 min — Technical deep-dive (infra + Dedicated sizing)
- 15 min — Q&A / next steps
- 5 min — Close + action items

Marissa will own recording and the run-of-show. Laura — can you lead the infra sizing piece and bring the Dedicated cost delta slide? If not, nominate backup.

Samantha — confirming recording storage: yes, we will place the recording and artifacts into the customer folder only (link to Drive will be shared post-call and access restricted). I’m attaching a compact agenda draft for quick review.

Proposed calendar invite: Thu Aug 20, 10:30–12:00 PT. If that works I’ll send the invite and Marissa will drop the run-of-show.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachment: compacted_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact QBR + roadmap: compressed window request

Karthik —

I can take the infra sizing. A couple of ops notes so we don’t bog the 30-minute deep-dive with too much detail:
- I’ll prepare a 10-slide pack focused on Dedicated throughput, latency SLOs, and expected unit costs for the two sizing profiles (baseline vs. peak).
- If procurement wants raw benchmark numbers we can send an appendix doc after the call; keep appendix offline during the session.
- Backup: if I’m pulled into another escalation, Marcus Lin can cover the sizing; I’ll sync with him now.

Marissa — pls confirm you can produce a sub-5min run-of-show and handle recording + Drive upload and apply the restricted folder ACLs. Also call recording consent language fine to send to legal?

Laura
Laura Bennett
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cogentcloud.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Compact QBR + roadmap: compressed window request

Thanks everyone — locking Thu Aug 20, 10:30–12:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Quick operational notes for the call:
- Run of show attached (run_of_show.xlsx).
- Recording: consent confirmed. Recording + slides will be uploaded to the restricted CogentCloud folder and we’ll share a single Drive link with viewer-only access for your team and read-only for legal.
- DocuSign: we nudged the updated SOW to procurement — link below; please route to the signatory once the QBR outcomes are agreed.
- HubSpot: I’ve updated the deal with the new QBR date and added the notes under DEAL-3241.

Samantha — please confirm final attendee list and whether procurement will join for the last 10–15 minutes. If procurement prefers an async appendix, we’ll deliver the appendix doc right after the call.

See you Thu —
Marissa Cole
Renewals Lead | Redwood Inference
